name: DESIGN.md Generator
summary: Figma plugin that turns local styles and variables into DESIGN.md and SKILL.md files for AI coding agents.
description: Extracts local styles and system signals from a Figma file — colors, typography, spacing, radius, effects, grids and component families — and generates editable DESIGN.md and SKILL.md markdown that gives AI tools a design-system blueprint. Actions cover auto-extract, generate DESIGN.md, generate SKILL.md, toggle view, refresh and download. Open source under the MIT license, based on the TypeUI DESIGN.md format.
contains: auto-extracts colors, typography, spacing, radius, effects, grids, component families
generates DESIGN.md and SKILL.md markdown files
based on the open-source TypeUI DESIGN.md format
actions: auto-extract, generate, toggle view, refresh, download
MIT licensed TypeScript plugin built with esbuild
